parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is a steel component forming one of the two arms of the tool. It is elongated and tapers toward the gripping or cutting end.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits the user's hand force to the gripping jaws, enabling the pliers to hold or cut objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers is the main structural part that includes the pivot joint and one handle. It is made of steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the central structure connecting the two legs and houses the pivot mechanism, ensuring smooth operation and alignment of the jaws.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary relative to the user's grip while the other leg moves around the pivot to open or close the jaws.
